mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the unemployment rate above 6% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and corporate earnings pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained unemployment above 6% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for three consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained GDP decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained high rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 for four consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 900,000 for three consecutive months signals weakening residential investment and consumer confidence, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained low housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) above 2.0% for three consecutive months signals robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) below $440 billion for three consecutive months signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained low real sales (t-test p > 0.05).
